title: Pure Live☆Twin
summary: Ki-sikil and Lil-la in both their forms, the Live☆Twin streamers and the Evil★Twin Link Monsters they become, with generic staples. The deck revolves around one-card starters that cycle between the twin partners to draw cards, destroy opposing threats, and climb into high-impact Link bosses.

summary.title: Starters
points: Live☆Twin Ki-sikil: Normal or Special Summoned while you control no other monsters, Special Summons any Lil-la monster directly from your hand or Deck.
Live☆Twin Lil-la: Normal or Special Summoned while you control no other monsters, Special Summons any Ki-sikil monster directly from your hand or Deck.
Live☆Twin Sunny's Snitch: Continuous Spell that adds any Live☆Twin monster on activation and burns the opponent for 200 LP each time they summon.
Secret Password: Adds any Live☆Twin or Evil★Twin Spell/Trap from Deck to hand, or searches an Evil★Twin monster if you control both Ki-sikil and Lil-la.
Live☆Twin Home: Quick-Play Spell that discards one card to Special Summon any Ki-sikil or Lil-la monster from your Deck.

summary.title: Opening: One-Twin Tag Link Ladder
steps: Normal Summon Live☆Twin Ki-sikil or Live☆Twin Lil-la, triggering its effect to Special Summon its partner from your Deck.
Link both twins into Evil★Twin Ki-sikil, then activate its effect to revive the Lil-la from your GY.
Link both monsters into Evil★Twin Lil-la, then activate Lil-la to revive Evil★Twin Ki-sikil from your GY, drawing one card off Ki-sikil's trigger.
Link both Evil★Twin monsters into Evil★Twin's Trouble Sunny.

During the opponent's turn, activate Trouble Sunny as a Quick Effect to send itself to the GY and revive both Evil★Twin Ki-sikil and Evil★Twin Lil-la, triggering Lil-la to destroy an opponent's card and Ki-sikil to draw.

summary.title: Extenders & 2025 Support
points: Live☆Twin Lil-la Sweet: Discards itself to negate an opponent's card or effect activated in response to your Live☆Twin activation, and revives itself from the GY.
Evil★Twin Ki-sikil Deal: Link-1 monster that sends a Lil-la monster from Deck to GY and draws a card whenever the opponent activates a card or effect in response to your twins.
Live☆Twin Ki-sikil Frost: Special Summons itself from hand if you control a Lil-la monster, and banishes itself from the GY to draw a card when the opponent adds a card to hand.
Live☆Twin Lil-la Treat: Special Summons itself from hand if you control a Ki-sikil monster, and lowers an opponent's monster's ATK when battle damage is taken.

summary.title: Payoffs & Traps
points: Evil★Twin's Trouble Sunny: Link-3 boss that tributes itself on either turn to revive both Evil★Twin Ki-sikil and Evil★Twin Lil-la, and banishes itself from the GY to send an opponent's card to the GY.
Evil★Twins Ki-sikil & Lil-la: Main Deck boss that tributes two Link Monsters to summon itself, forcing the opponent to send cards to the GY until they control only two.
Evil★Twin Challenge: Quick-Play Trap that revives a Ki-sikil or Lil-la monster and immediately performs an Evil★Twin Link Summon.
Evil★Twin Present: Targets an Evil★Twin to exchange control with an opponent's monster or spins an opponent's Set Spell/Trap back to the Deck.
